fields.statement: Verifier at c57cac64 (review fix for the confirmed macOS finding). Read the diff: ReadMachine now takes load from readLoadavg, /proc/loadavg on !darwin (load_proc.go) and unix.SysctlRaw("vm.loadavg") on darwin (load_darwin.go), parsed by ParseSysctlLoadavg (three uint32 fixed-point averages, padding, int64 fscale at offset 16, matching struct loadavg on 64-bit); memory stays /proc-only so macOS skips only the memory check, as the shape decision says; an unreadable sysctl leaves LoadOK false and never holds. go.mod moves golang.org/x/sys v0.47.0 from indirect to direct, same version. Ran: go test -trimpath ./internal/daemon/... ok (includes TestParseSysctlLoadavg: 2.5/1.25 at scale 2048, short and zero-scale inputs fail); GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go vet ./internal/daemon and go build ./cmd/rhiza ok; gofmt -l clean; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/daemon-load: daemon-load-hold and daemon-load-settings PASS. The darwin path itself was not run on a Mac.
